name: Maya Thompson
headline: Junior Content Marketing Specialist
summary: Detail-oriented content marketer with 2 years of experience developing SEO-driven content strategies and engaging copy for digital brands. Skilled in keyword research, editorial planning, and cross-channel content creation to drive organic growth.

responsibilities: Develop and execute content strategy for client blogs and social channels
Conduct keyword research and optimize on-page SEO for articles
Collaborate with design team to create visual content assets
Track content performance using Google Analytics and adjust strategy accordingly
Assisted in drafting blog posts and email newsletters
Supported SEO audits and competitor analysis
Managed social media scheduling using Hootsuite
Compiled monthly performance reports for content initiatives
